cohort: 13,792,544 women who delivered between 1999 and 2015 in the United States.
finding: Pregnant women with HS had a greater likelihood of developing preeclampsia, delivering by cesarean section, and having a baby with congenital anomalies compared to women without HS.
mod_finding: Women with HS were more likely to deliver by cesarean section (OR 1.78, 95% CI 1.56-2.02).
